title: Old friend? Mortal enemy!
next_chapter_hook: That man who should have died long ago—why has he become Heaven's executioner? And does the token clutched in his hand hold the answer Chen Ji has been desperately seeking?

text.content: Night as dark as ink, cold wind carrying withered leaves across the window lattice, rustling softly. After Mo Xiansheng's figure vanished like smoke, the ancient jade slip lay motionless on the table, its cracks deepened by another strand—like fate's silent mockery. Chen Ji sat alone before the window, fingertips unconsciously tracing the jade slip's fractures, the faint glow of the Tianji Record flickering in the darkness like some dormant fierce beast stirring to wake. "The Death Executor..." he murmured, his voice hoarse enough to sound unfamiliar even to himself. Tonight would be sleepless, and he had to know—just who was coming to reap his life.

He drew a deep breath, pressing the last shred of理智 into the depths of his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record Fragment unfurled at his will, golden runes slithering up his meridians like serpents, bringing searing agony. Every glimpse of heavenly secrets burned away his Heavenly Fate Value—and these five points alone could shake an ordinary disciple's foundation. But at this moment, Chen Ji's eyes held only cold resolve. Since fate intended to take his life, he would first peer into the very fangs of destiny.

dialogue.content: (Grinding teeth, murmuring) Show me... the complete vision of death's prophecy!

text.content: The Tianji Record convulsed violently, runes dimming abruptly before erupting with blinding golden light. In his Mental Sea, images surged forth like a tide—fragmented, incomplete, yet carrying the stench of blood. There was a cliff, and below it churned swirling ink-dark clouds; there was a figure, back turned toward him, shoulders straight as a pine, yet permeated with suffocating death energy.

As the image sharpened, Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The figure turned around—a handsome face covered in scars, eyes that had once been warm as jade now hollow as an abyss. Memories exploded like thunder, pinning Chen Ji to the spot. It's him... how can this be...

Zhou Ran. His old friend whom he believed had died ten years ago in that sect chaos. He had witnessed with his own eyes the corpse torn apart by magic beasts, blood staining half the mountain forest red. The grave he had亲手 erected still burned in the deepest corner of his memory. But the figure in the Tianji Record was unmistakably Zhou Ran—no, not entirely. That person's aura was too cold, too... inhuman.

The Tianji Record seemed to sense his turmoil, the image wrenching to a new scene. At the cliff's edge, Zhou Ran cradled a pitch-black token in one hand, the token engraved with a closed eye—the mark of the Eye of Heaven. And Zhou Ran's lips formed words burned into Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Old friend, I've come to send you on your way." Icy words, yet carrying a twisted tenderness.

choice.prompt: Facing this earth-shattering truth, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Face the truth directly, question the Tianji Record
choices.description: Activate the deepest layer of the Tianji Record's memory, forcibly trace why Zhou Ran became a Death Executor—the cost is an additional 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock key information: The contract details between Zhou Ran and the Eye of Heaven
choices.risk_hint: May expose traces of Tianji Record usage, alerting the Eye of Heaven

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, forcibly urging the Tianji Record's core. A piercing agony burst from his Brow Center, golden runes igniting madly, as if ten thousand needles were piercing through his Mental Sea. Yet the image grew sharper—he saw it clearly. That battle ten years ago was no accident, but a chess game meticulously arranged by the Eye of Heaven. Zhou Ran hadn't died; he was rescued, but the price was becoming a chess piece of Heaven's will, permanently branded as a Death Executor.

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) What a fine resurrection scheme... So I was the one kept blind in the dark this whole time.

text.content: The cost was brutal—Heavenly Fate Value plummeted to a dangerous zone, Chen Ji felt his life force draining visibly. But the fragments of truth had assembled: Zhou Ran hadn't acted willingly; he too was a pitiful puppet controlled by the Eye of Heaven. And that pitch-black token was the shackle binding him. Perhaps destroying it could reverse this certain-death situation.

choices.text: Investigate the truth, contact the hidden informant
choices.description: Utilize the underground network established over years, probe for Zhou Ran's intelligence from the crevice between the Demonic Path and Heaven's gambit—a intelligence fee will be consumed.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain external intelligence verification: Whether what the Tianji Record displayed is true
choices.risk_hint: The hidden line may have been compromised, intelligence may have been tampered with

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his churning emotions, trembling fingers retrieving a blood-colored jade token from the Hidden Compartment. It was the contact token for the underground network he had established years ago—the "Spider Silk" in the gray zone between the Demonic Path and the righteous world. The moment the token activated, a cold divine sense transmitted: "What orders does the honored guest have?" Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then uttered a name: "Zhou Ran." A brief shock came from the other end, followed by a rustling sound of pages being turned.

dialogue.content: (Lowering his voice) I want to know everything about him—alive or dead, I must see him.

text.content: Half an hour later, the intelligence arrived as promised. The name 'Zhou Ran' appeared prominently on the Heavenly Dao Assassin's List, codename 'Homeward Path', nominated personally by the Eye of Heavenly Dao ten years ago, with a perfect success rate, never failing a mission. More critically—beside the name was an annotation: 'This chess piece is special, maintain observation, do not activate lightly.' This meant Zhou Ran had been in a dormant state all along, until... Chen Ji's power from the Tianji Record began to awaken.

choices.description: Since he knew who the Death Executor was, Chen Ji decided to take the initiative, setting up an inescapable net before the other party could make a move.
choices.visible_reward: Gain strategic initiative: can predict Zhou Ran's movements without his knowledge
choices.risk_hint: If Zhou Ran's strength far exceeds expectations, he may become the prey instead

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the shock into the deepest part of his Mental Sea. When he opened them again, his gaze had returned to its usual calm, even carrying a hint of cold amusement. Zhou Ran, since you've appeared, don't blame your old friend for not showing mercy. He began rapidly deducing in his mind—Zhou Ran's personality, Zhou Ran's weaknesses, Zhou Ran's possible routes of action. The Zhou Ran of ten years ago valued friendship and righteousness, but what about the Zhou Ran of today?

dialogue.content: (Murmuring) Since we're old acquaintances, you should know my habit—I never do anything without a way out.

text.content: He left a hidden spiritual consciousness mark in the Tianji Record—this was one of his rare moments of deliberate exposure, but also an elaborately designed bait. As long as Zhou Ran drew near, he would sense it immediately. At the same time, he discreetly sent an encrypted message to Ye Qing: 'An old friend visits, I need your Demonic Path mist.' Having done all this, Chen Ji lay back on his couch contentedly, a meaningful smile curving his lips.

The images from the Tianji Record slowly faded before his eyes, finally定格 on the black token in Zhou Ran's hand. The closed eye symbolized Heavenly Dao's absolute control over fate—those chosen had nowhere to escape, only to wait for harvest. But Chen Ji noticed a detail: the fingers gripping the token were trembling slightly. That wasn't a killer's cold ruthlessness, but... struggle.

dialogue.content: (Coldly) Ten years apart, you've learned to hide your thoughts. Unfortunately, we know each other too well.

text.content: From the depths of his Mental Sea, the residual consciousness of Mo Xiansheng suddenly flickered with light, an ancient voice ringing in his heart: 'The Death Executor is neither human nor ghost, but an projection of Heavenly Dao's will. His choice of Zhou Ran must have its reasons... Has the host ever considered that an old acquaintance from the past may never have truly left?' These words were like a bucket of cold water, making Chen Ji suddenly realize a detail he'd overlooked—the day Zhou Ran 'died' was exactly the day Chen Ji himself entered the Tianqing Sect.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words raised deeper questions—

choices.text: Investigate the connection between Zhou Ran's 'death' and the Tianqing Sect
choices.description: Investigate survivors and records from the chaotic battle ten years ago, trying to find the connection between Zhou Ran's 'faked death' and the Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_cost: Time cost: may miss the opportunity to take initiative
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden plotline: Zhou Ran and Ling Yuan's past
choices.risk_hint: Investigation may alert Ling Yuan, drawing unnecessary attention

text.content: Chen Ji infiltrated the deepest Forbidden Grounds of the scripture repository that very night. Dust-laden scrolls recorded the truth of that chaotic battle—on the surface it was a Demonic Path ambush, but in reality there was the shadow of a Tianqing Sect insider. And that insider's codename matched remarkably with Chen Ji's guide when he entered the sect... Ling Yuan. That old sect master who had shown him such 'care and concern' had set up this chess game as early as ten years ago.

dialogue.content: (Chuckling coldly) What deep scheming... So from the day I entered, I was already a chess piece.

text.content: The puzzle pieces gradually came together: Zhou Ran was not an ordinary Death Executor, he was the 'token of submission' Ling Yuan sacrificed to the Eye of Heavenly Dao. In exchange, Ling Yuan obtained the old sect master's seat, while Zhou Ran became a key piece in Heavenly Dao's chess game—specifically designed to deal with Chen Ji, who might threaten Ling Yuan. This was a murder spanning ten years, and only now did Chen Ji see the hunter's face clearly.

choices.description: Convey a signal to Zhou Ran through special channels, forcing him to appear for confrontation, high risk high reward.
choices.visible_cost: High risk: may directly trigger the death prophecy
choices.visible_reward: May awaken Zhou Ran's original heart, striving to gain a powerful insider ally.
choices.risk_hint: If Zhou Ran has been completely controlled by the Heavenly Dao, they may strike immediately.

text.content: Chen Ji made a crazy decision. He took out a long-yellowed communication talisman—that was a token from ten years ago between him and Zhou Ran, a promise that regardless of life or death, if one called, the other would surely come. He injected his divine sense into the talisman, saying only one sentence: "Old place, under the osmanthus tree. I'll be waiting." That was where they cultivated together as children. Chen Ji was gambling—that Zhou Ran's original heart had not yet completely died.

dialogue.content: (Gazing as the communication talisman turned to ash) Zhou Ran, I give you a chance to choose—don't let me down.

text.content: The night wind rose abruptly, and Chen Ji pushed open the door, rushing toward the century-old osmanthus tree on the Rear Mountain. The moonlight was like frost, and beneath the tree stood no one, but Chen Ji was not flustered. He knew Zhou Ran would surely come—because the other end of that communication talisman connected not just through space, but also through memories from ten years ago. The Eye of Heavenly Dao could control Zhou Ran's body, but it could not erase those bonds carved into his soul. He was gambling, betting that Zhou Ran still retained a final thread of humanity.

However, at this moment, the Tianji Record's warning suddenly roared. Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, only to see the moonlight torn apart by a black shadow—that was a figure he knew from the depths of his heart yet felt utterly unfamiliar. Zhou Ran descended from the moon, his black robe fluttering dramatically. His once warm and gentle features were now covered in eerie black patterns, as if something had completely eroded him. In his hand, he gripped precisely that pitch-black token carved with a closed eye.

dialogue.content: (Voice low and grave) You've arrived. Ten years apart, old friend.
(Zhou Ran, a flicker of struggle passing through his hollow eyes) You shouldn't have come... you shouldn't have come, Chen Ji.

text.content: Zhou Ran's voice was hoarse and shattered, as if something inside him was being violently torn apart. Chen Ji saw—Zhou Ran's fingers gripping the token had turned bone-white, and the black patterns were spreading visibly toward his heart. He was resisting, fighting against the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control with his own will! In this moment, Chen Ji had calculated his strategy.

choice.prompt: Facing his old friend who is struggling against fate, Chen Ji—

choices.text: Using old sentiments to shake Zhou Ran's original heart
choices.description: Awakening the memories from ten years ago, using brotherhood to help Zhou Ran break free from control, high risk but potentially gaining the strongest ally.
choices.visible_cost: If unsuccessful, will be judged as a "traitor" by the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Zhou Ran completely turns allegiance, becoming a key piece in opposing the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may forcibly seize Zhou Ran's body at the critical moment

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped forward, standing before Zhou Ran. His gaze passed through those terrifying black patterns, landing deep within those eyes that once shone bright as stars. "Zhou Ran, do you still remember?" he said softly, "That year when you were bullied, who stood in front of you? When you first comprehended sword qi, who accompanied you through three days and nights of practice? You said you would become a great hero in this lifetime, eliminating all injustice—" Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose sharply, "Have you forgotten all of this?!"

dialogue.content: (Low shout) If you are still that Zhou Ran from back then, then wake up for me!

text.content: Zhou Ran trembled violently, and the spread of the black patterns actually stopped! He clutched his head, letting out an agonized howl: "Stop talking... stop talking!" But at the same time, a cold consciousness exploded from his Brow Center—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had sensed the betrayal, forcibly trying to reclaim control. Chen Ji cursed inwardly, the Tianji Record immediately unfolding as golden runes clashed head-on with the closed eye on that pitch-black token! A golden and black light fiercely collided beneath the osmanthus tree, and the entire mountain forest trembled.

choices.text: Forcefully interfering with the Heavenly Dao connection using the Tianji Record
choices.description: Utilizing the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to temporarily sever Zhou Ran's connection with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, buying time to awaken him.
choices.visible_cost: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate, leaving oneself in a weakened state
choices.visible_reward: During the severed connection, Zhou Ran can act freely and provide crucial intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May enrage the Eye of Heavenly Dao, triggering more intense pursuit

text.content: Chen Ji's palms formed seals, and the Tianji Record Fragment blazed with unprecedented dazzling golden light. That was power transcending what this body could withstand. The sizzling sound of burning runes filled the air, yet he forcefully tore a crack between Zhou Ran and the Eye of Heavenly Dao. "Get back!" Chen Ji roared, and something in his Mental Sea felt as if it had been severed. Zhou Ran let out a miserable cry, staggering backward several steps.

dialogue.content: (Straining forcefully) Now only you can hear me—tell me, how do I break the token's control!

text.content: Zhou Ran's gaze gradually cleared from the chaos. Looking at this figure even more disheveled than himself, tears slipped down silently. "Chen Ji... how could you be so foolish..." he rasped, "That token... only the Heavenly Eye's true form can undo it... but there's a way..." He grabbed Chen Ji's hand abruptly, "Find my sister... Chen Nian... she's... the Heavenly Fate Lock Key... only she can..." Before he could finish, the black token erupted with terrifying energy once more—the Heavenly Eye was fighting back furiously!

The Tianji Record's warning flashed madly in the Mental Sea—the time for the death prophecy was rapidly approaching. Chen Ji knew that tonight's appointment beneath the osmanthus tree had touched the most dangerous string in the fate chess game. Zhou Ran's words struck like thunder: Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Nian. His sister who had been missing for years actually held the key to breaking Heaven's control? This discovery changed everything—it was no longer merely a life-and-death showdown, but a crucial turning point affecting the entire chess game's trajectory.

dialogue.content: (Whispering) So that's how it is... The answer I've been searching for all along... was always by my side.

text.content: The jet-black token erupted with its final frenzy, a majestic consciousness descending from the Nine Heavens. That was the Heavenly Eye's gaze—cold, majestic, devoid of any emotion. Chen Ji felt as if gripped by an invisible giant hand, breathing becoming difficult. But he didn't retreat; instead, he raised his head toward that consciousness, a cold smile curling his lips. "Do you see it?" he said in his heart, "This is the chess piece you selected—one still defying you." At that moment, Chen Ji made his decision: Zhou Ran, this chess piece abandoned by Heaven, would become the key to overturning the entire game.
